description: NFX-10 §6.10. 'messages' MUST each close the channel when received (a protocol error). 'sequences' are messages one side sends in order, a hello first: the receiving server MUST close the channel at the last one. 'beacons_refused' are beacons answers a reader MUST refuse whole; 'reader_refused' are beacons a reader MUST refuse at 'now' when it plays 'video'. 'reason' is informative.
